exceptions.trustBoundary: Development test configuration and filesystem glob patterns; not a production dependency.
exceptions.preconditions: A deeply nested attacker-controlled brace pattern must reach braces compilation/expansion. Karma consumes repository test configuration/globs; application request values are not passed to it. No patched braces release is available in the inspected owner range.
exceptions.mitigation: Use reviewed repository glob patterns, never user-supplied patterns. Owned verification runs Karma on loopback with retries disabled. Do not expose standalone Karma or run untrusted repository/test code with credentials.
exceptions.followUp: Complete the staged Angular spec conversion and retire Karma in v0.3.1 Phase 5, before the original expiry; do not downgrade Karma or renew this exception.

exceptions.trustBoundary: Local schema tooling only. Production migrations use Drizzle ORM, not the Drizzle Kit CLI.
exceptions.preconditions: The vulnerable esbuild serve API must be started and a developer must visit an attacker-controlled website. drizzle-kit generate loads trusted local schema and generates SQL without starting esbuild serve. The legacy loader pins ~0.18.20, outside the fixed >=0.25.0 line.
exceptions.mitigation: Use Drizzle Kit only for local generation from reviewed schema; do not use drizzle-kit studio or start esbuild serve from this legacy graph. Do not expose schema tooling to a network or run it against untrusted schema/config.
exceptions.followUp: Adopt a maintainer release removing the legacy loader, or evaluate a separately scoped Drizzle Kit migration before expiry. Do not downgrade Kit to npm's suggested 0.18.1.
